title: Menu height can exceed available screen height making items unreachable
line: Long Global Menu menus and submenus now fit on screen and scroll, so their first items can be reached.
explanation: The Global Menu shows the app's menus as QMenus, and QMenu sizes a long menu for the whole screen height. The panel takes part of that space, so the compositor pushed the menu up past the top edge of the screen: the first items were off-screen and there was no scroll-up arrow (submenus lost their first item the same way). The applet now limits the menu and all its submenus to the screen height left free by panels, so QMenu shows scroll arrows inside the visible area.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: keep menus within the available screen height

Long menus were sized for the whole screen, so they got pushed past the
screen edge to stay clear of the panel, hiding their first items. Limit
menus and submenus to the available screen height so they scroll.

BUG: 497515

media.caption: Before: a 70-item menu from the Global Menu starts above the screen; items 1-44 can't be reached and there is no scroll-up arrow.
After: the menu fits between the top of the screen and the panel, with a scroll arrow; hovering it scrolls back to item 1 (right).
Before: a 70-item submenu is also taller than the free space and its first item is off-screen.
After: the submenu fits on screen, starting at item 1, with a scroll-down arrow.
